title: Block transfer with OSCORE
notes: BLOCKED 2026-08-26 Phase-2 audit (not claimed; no source edits): the required production Block1/Block2-over-OSCORE integration does not exist end to end in Rust. rust/lichen-coap/src/client.rs explicitly documents "no block-wise transfer"; rust/lichen-coap/src/block.rs provides only standalone BlockSender/BlockReceiver primitives, and rust/lichen-node SecureStack exposes generic secure request/response methods but never orchestrates those block states, per-block acknowledgements, retries, or reassembly. Python delegates generic blockwise behavior to aiocoap, but secure lifecycle tests explicitly use handle_blockwise=False and no test was found proving each block is independently OSCORE-protected/correlated/replay-checked through SecureDatagramChannel. Canonical blockwise vectors are also missing: project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.7.2 remains open for transport vectors, and no test/vectors/*block* file exists. project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.9.11.3 (Large payload fragmentation Block1/Block2) remains open with acceptance "Block1/Block2 transfers work". A live agent owns python/src/lichen/crypto/oscore.py and rust/lichen-oscore/** for key-update work, so those files were kept read-only. Leave this bead open/unassigned until the Rust production client/secure-stack blockwise prerequisite and canonical vectors land; then verify independent per-block PIVs, Block1 Continue/resize, Block2 sequencing, duplicate/replay/out-of-order/truncated/oversize failures, correlation cleanup, and final payload equality in both Python and Rust. Zephyr blockwise remains separately open/excluded.
